# 9. Temporal Trends in Snow Depth Thresholds

## 9.1 Beta-Binomial Models (90 cm & 100 cm)

```{r}
#| label: trend-snow-calc
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Model yearly trends in snow day counts (trials = number of days with snow coverage) using a beta-binomial distribution to account for overdispersion and zero.
# 1. 90 cm threshold
beta_90 <- brm(
  bf(days_gt_90 | trials(days_count) ~ Year_trend),  
  data = snow,
  family = beta_binomial(),
  chains = 4, iter = 6000, warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4, seed = 123, backend = "cmdstanr"
)

# 2. 100 cm threshold
beta_100 <- brm(
  bf(days_gt_100 | trials(days_count) ~ Year_trend),  
  data = snow,
  family = beta_binomial(),
  chains = 4, iter = 6000, warmup = 2000,
  cores = 4, seed = 123, backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: trend-snow-results
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Diagnostics: 90 cm Model 
pp_check(beta_90, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
pp_check(beta_90, type = "stat", stat = "sd")
pp_check(beta_90, type = "stat", stat = function(y) mean(y == 0))
pp_check(beta_90, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 50)

trend_90_powerscale <- powerscale_sensitivity(beta_90)
summary(beta_90)
p_direction(beta_90)

ft_beta90 <- flextable(extract_brms_summary(beta_90, "90")) |> autofit()
doc <- read_docx()       
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_beta90)   
print(doc, target = "beta90.docx")

# Diagnostics: 100 cm Model
pp_check(beta_100, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
pp_check(beta_100, type = "stat", stat = "sd")
pp_check(beta_100, type = "stat", stat = function(y) mean(y == 0), bins = 30)
pp_check(beta_100, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 50)

trend_100_powerscale <- powerscale_sensitivity(beta_100)
summary(beta_100) 
p_direction(beta_100)

ft_beta100 <- flextable(extract_brms_summary(beta_100, "100")) |> autofit()
doc <- read_docx()       
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_beta100)   
print(doc, target = "beta100.docx")
```

## 9.2 Graphical Visualization of Snow Threshold Trends

```{r}
#| label: trend-snow-plots
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Setup time horizon for simulations (1979 to 2023)
Year_trend_seq <- seq(from = 0, to = 44, by = 1) 
n_Year <- length(Year_trend_seq)

# 1. 90 cm Threshold: Simulation and occurrence probability

draws_90 <- as_draws_df(beta_90)
n_sims_90 <- nrow(draws_90)

prob_matrix_90 <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_sims_90, ncol = n_Year)

for (i in 1:n_sims_90) {
  eta <- draws_90$b_Intercept[i] + draws_90$b_Year_trend[i] * Year_trend_seq
  mu_i <- plogis(eta)
  prob_zero <- dbeta_binomial(x = 0, size = 365, mu = mu_i, phi = draws_90$phi[i])
  prob_matrix_90[i, ] <- 1 - prob_zero
}

prob_mean_90 <- apply(prob_matrix_90, MARGIN = 2, FUN = mean)
ci_lower_90  <- apply(prob_matrix_90, MARGIN = 2, FUN = quantile, probs = 0.025)
ci_upper_90  <- apply(prob_matrix_90, MARGIN = 2, FUN = quantile, probs = 0.975)

snow$binary_gt_90 <- ifelse(snow$days_gt_90 > 0, 1, 0)

df_plot_90 <- data.frame(
  Year_trend = Year_trend_seq,
  prob_mean   = prob_mean_90,
  ci_lower    = ci_lower_90,
  ci_upper    = ci_upper_90
)

prob_90 <- ggplot(df_plot_90, aes(x = Year_trend)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_mean), color = "#4575b4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = snow, aes(x = Year_trend, y = binary_gt_90), alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 44, by = 10), 
    labels = seq(1979, 2024, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, 44)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Probability of at least one day ≥ 90cm"
  ) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
  )

# Conditional count curve for 90 cm
ce_90 <- conditional_effects(beta_90, effects = "Year_trend")
ce_90 <- ce_90$Year_trend

plot_ce90 <- ggplot(ce_90, aes(x = Year_trend, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "#4575b4", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = snow, aes(x = Year_trend, y = days_gt_90), alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of days ≥ 90cm") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 44, by = 10), 
    labels = seq(1979, 2024, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, 44)
  ) +
  theme_pubr()

# 2. 100 cm Threshold: Simulation and occurrence probability
draws_100 <- as_draws_df(beta_100)
n_sims_100 <- nrow(draws_100)

prob_matrix_100 <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_sims_100, ncol = n_Year)

for (i in 1:n_sims_100) {
  eta_100 <- draws_100$b_Intercept[i] + draws_100$b_Year_trend[i] * Year_trend_seq
  mu_i_100 <- plogis(eta_100)
  prob_zero_100 <- dbeta_binomial(x = 0, size = 365, mu = mu_i_100, phi = draws_100$phi[i])
  prob_matrix_100[i, ] <- 1 - prob_zero_100
}

prob_mean_100 <- apply(prob_matrix_100, MARGIN = 2, FUN = mean)
ci_lower_100  <- apply(prob_matrix_100, MARGIN = 2, FUN = quantile, probs = 0.025)
ci_upper_100  <- apply(prob_matrix_100, MARGIN = 2, FUN = quantile, probs = 0.975)

snow$binary_gt_100 <- ifelse(snow$days_gt_100 > 0, 1, 0)

df_plot_100 <- data.frame(
  Year_trend = Year_trend_seq,
  prob_mean   = prob_mean_100,
  ci_lower    = ci_lower_100,
  ci_upper    = ci_upper_100
)

prob_100 <- ggplot(df_plot_100, aes(x = Year_trend)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_mean), color = "#4575b4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = snow, aes(x = Year_trend, y = binary_gt_100), alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 44, by = 10), 
    labels = seq(1979, 2024, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, 44)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Probability of at least one day ≥ 100cm"
  ) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
  )

# Conditional count curve for 100 cm
ce_100 <- conditional_effects(beta_100, effects = "Year_trend")
ce_100 <- ce_100$Year_trend

plot_ce100 <- ggplot(ce_100, aes(x = Year_trend, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "#4575b4", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = snow, aes(x = Year_trend, y = days_gt_100), alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 44, by = 10), 
    labels = seq(1979, 2024, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, 44)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of days ≥ 100cm") +
  theme_pubr()
```
